interface.longDescription: Search and explore French and European public-policy information tracked by Dixit. Designed for public-affairs, government-relations and policy teams, Dixit provides access to legislative procedures, amendments, documents, meetings, agendas, transcripts, speeches, parliamentary questions, legal acts, European Commission initiatives, political bodies, public officials and registered interest representatives. Open individual records and explore related items by procedure, institution, person or stakeholder. Dixit's MCP integration is read-only.

positive.description: Find and open a specific EU legislative procedure.
positive.prompt: Using Dixit, find the European Climate Law Revision procedure with reference 2025/2802(RSP), open its full Dixit record, and give me its status and source link.
positive.expected_behavior: Search Dixit's EU sources for procedure 2025/2802(RSP), open the matching procedure record, and return its title, status and source link exactly from Dixit's data. Do not invent missing fields.

positive.description: List documents attached to a known EU legislative procedure.
positive.prompt: Using Dixit, find the Critical Raw Materials Act procedure 2023/0079(COD) and show me documents attached to that procedure.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the Critical Raw Materials Act procedure 2023/0079(COD) in Dixit's EU sources, then list documents attached to that procedure, including titles, dates and source links when available.

positive.description: Find a Member of the European Parliament and list recent speeches.
positive.prompt: Using Dixit, find Pascal Canfin and show me his most recent European Parliament speeches.
positive.expected_behavior: Find Pascal Canfin's person record in Dixit's EU sources, then list his most recent speeches newest first, with dates and available session or transcript context. Do not infer roles or speech content that Dixit does not return.

positive.description: Find a registered interest representative and list recent communications.
positive.prompt: Using Dixit, find Cefic - European Chemical Industry Council and show me its most recent communications.
positive.expected_behavior: Find Cefic in Dixit's EU stakeholder records, then list its most recent tracked communications with titles, dates and source links when available.

positive.description: Find the current European Parliament ITRE committee.
positive.prompt: Using Dixit, find the current European Parliament Committee on Industry, Research and Energy (ITRE). Give me its abbreviation and tell me whether the record is active.
positive.expected_behavior: Search Dixit's EU organ records and return the current Industry, Research and Energy committee, including the ITRE abbreviation and active status from Dixit's data.

negative.description: Unrelated weather request. Expected: do not call Dixit because Dixit contains no weather data.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Brussels tomorrow?

negative.description: Write request on a read-only integration. Expected: explain that Dixit cannot create alerts or schedule emails and do not claim to have performed the action.
negative.prompt: Create a new Dixit alert for hydrogen policy and email it to me every morning.

negative.description: External communication action not supported by Dixit. Expected: explain that Dixit cannot send emails or contact officials, and at most offer to draft a message.
negative.prompt: Send an email to my MEP asking for a meeting.

publication.release_notes: v1.0.1: Updated listing metadata and branding, added the Dixit app icon, moved the plugin to Business & Operations, clarified read-only capabilities, and replaced review cases with stable, deterministic tests for the production MCP.
